name: Portugal-based designer seeking genuine location freedom

context.geography: Currently Portugal; wants Europe-compatible work from anywhere
constraints: Needs clear permitted countries and timezone overlap
Wants location freedom beyond a home-office label
Does not want to change country solely for payroll eligibility
context.company_awareness: Knows some remote-first brands but is open to specialist discovery

trigger: The current employer clarifies that remote work is allowed only from one registered address, prompting a search for roles with broader location flexibility.

searches_run.query: senior product designer remote Europe work from anywhere
searches_run.observation: Results ranged from remote EU-timezone employer pages to aggregators and Europe-only listings. Remote, Europe, named countries and anywhere language appeared in different combinations, so none was treated as interchangeable.

searches_run.query: product designer remote Portugal timezone country restrictions jobs
searches_run.observation: Results included a Reedsy country list containing Portugal, a RemoFirst list of permitted locations and WhiteTech's broad Europe/CET wording. Direct WhiteTech inspection showed location flexibility alongside timezone conditions and an application question about residence.

sources.title: Senior Product Designer — Primeline
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet advertises remote EU timezones and senior design responsibilities; it does not establish unrestricted country mobility.

sources.title: Senior Product Designer - Remote Europe — Reedsy
sources.supports: Retrieved ATS snippet lists Portugal among locations and says Europe-based applicants only. That is not proof of an unrestricted travel policy.

sources.title: Senior Product Designer — WhiteTech
sources.supports: Directly inspected ATS page welcomes European applicants and mentions CET-compatible applicants elsewhere; benefits describe flexible remote work within CET. Application asks country of residence. This establishes wording to clarify, not legal or contractual mobility.

best_entry_page.primary_query: remote product designer Europe country restrictions
best_entry_page.promise: Compare remote design roles using the employer's stated countries, timezone requirements and work-location wording, then follow the companies that fit.
best_entry_page.cta: Search senior remote design roles and save the suitable employers.
proof_needed: Display work mode separately from allowed countries and time overlap.
Show source excerpts for broad location claims and label missing travel policies unknown.
Test description checks against country lists and timezone exceptions.
Demonstrate coverage of design employers and relevant senior roles.
A new indexable guide is required; the current filtered results are noindex.

conversion_objections: Will remote just mean remote within the employer's country?
Does Portugal appear explicitly or only Europe?
Can I distinguish a timezone requirement from a residence rule?
Can I travel while employed, or does anywhere only describe recruitment?
Will descriptions tell me if the role is UX product work rather than graphic design?

avoid_targeting.query: digital nomad tax Portugal work anywhere
avoid_targeting.reason: Tax and legal mobility advice are outside the product.

avoid_targeting.query: worldwide product designer jobs guaranteed any country
avoid_targeting.reason: No tool can guarantee every employer/country combination.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I already have a remote job; the question is where I am actually allowed to work. Show me the country and timezone wording so I can shortlist roles worth a conversation instead of reading another page of remote badges.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic selective candidate. Two queries and one direct inspection support a distinction between remote labels and source conditions, not actual employer compliance or mobility rights. Citizenship, contractual arrangement and intended travel pattern remain unspecified.

search_journey.fit_reason: Occupation, seniority and region search fit.
Must read restrictions rather than trust remote tags.
